api.base_url: https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com/v2.0/{tenantId}/{environmentName}/api/v2.0 (host/prefix from Nango providers.yaml; /api/v2.0 from Microsoft API v2.0 reference title)
api.openapi_spec_url: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/api-reference/v2.0/dynamics-open-api (linked as "OpenAPI specification" from the v2.0 index page)

scopes_needed_read: https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com/.default (application permission API.ReadWrite.All; exact app permission name UNVERIFIED on fetched page)
auth.refresh: Client credentials: request new token with secret/cert; authcode flow also supported via Entra

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: None needed to call standard APIs; AppSource only for extensions
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Entra admin consents to our multi-tenant app (admin consent URL); BC admin opens Microsoft Entra Applications page in the environment, adds our client ID, sets state Enabled and assigns permission sets (e.g. D365 READ / API-access sets). Step wording partially UNVERIFIED (S2S doc page found by search only).
access_requirements.cost_to_us: Free; customer API entitlement is part of BC license (API calls throttled by BC service limits)
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Same day after customer admin consent

sandbox.how_to_get: Free BC online sandbox via Microsoft 365 Developer Program or a trial tenant (UNVERIFIED page)

rate_limits: UNVERIFIED on fetched page (BC online enforces per-environment operational limits incl. 6000 requests per 5 min per user per general knowledge; not confirmed)

events: API webhook subscriptions on entities (create/update/delete); details UNVERIFIED

incremental_sync: OData $filter=lastModifiedDateTime gt {cursor} on API v2.0 entities; webhooks supplement
blockers: Per-customer environment name and tenant ID needed; customer must add our app inside BC, not only in Entra
sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/api-reference/v2.0/ - "APIs for Business Central online are enabled by default"; links OpenAPI specification

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/business-central/dev-itpro/administration/automation-apis-using-s2s-authentication - "S2S authentication uses the Client Credentials OAuth 2.0 Flow" (via search)
